clue.text: I heal a bitter rift and restore name

indicators.note: a rift is a split or breach, so the letters of the preceding words are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A peacemaker mends a bitter quarrel and clears someone's reputation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rift' looks like part of the quarrel picture but signals that I HEAL A BITTER is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: To rehabilitate someone is to clear their reputation and return their good standing.

clue.text: Show delight about novelist's talk

parts.note: re is a Latin-derived word meaning about or concerning

indicators.note: talk signals that the novelist's name is taken as it is spoken, not as it is written

parts.note: James Joyce is the Irish novelist of Ulysses

explanation.surface: Someone shows pleasure on hearing a famous writer give a lecture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'talk' means the novelist's name as spoken: James Joyce is the Irish author of Ulysses.
explanation.definitionFit: To rejoice is to be glad and express happiness openly.

clue.text: Mercury he noted: boiling, outside, start of lovely summer

indicators.note: outside says the word for boiling wraps around the following letters

parts.note: boiling means very hot

indicators.note: start of picks only the opening letter of the word lovely

parts.note: S is a standard abbreviation for summer

explanation.surface: A scene of a scorching day at the start of a beautiful summer, with the planet Mercury observed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mercury' looks like the planet or the metal, but it is one movement of The Planets suite, which the composer set down in music: 'noted' means wrote the notes.
explanation.definitionFit: Gustav Holst composed The Planets, whose movements include one titled after the winged messenger planet.

clue.text: Who takes her to the musical?

definitions.text: Who takes her to the musical?

parts.words: Who takes her to the musical?
parts.note: reads as asking about a young woman's date for a show, but it also names a famous 1950s stage musical by Sandy Wilson

explanation.definitionFit: A girl's escort or sweetheart is her regular date, and The Boy Friend is also a well-known musical.

clue.text: Not quite the female a herdsman expected

definitions.text: Not quite the female a herdsman expected

indicators.note: not quite says the letters lie within the words that follow, only partly present across them

explanation.surface: A herdsman is disappointed when the woman he gets is not the one he hoped for.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also defines: Jacob, Laban's herdsman, worked for Rachel but was first given her elder sister.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis she was the bride Jacob received by trickery instead of her sister Rachel, whom he had served seven years to win.

clue.text: Hey! Tests somehow reveal he ate his own children

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters arrive by some unspecified rearrangement

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims as medical tests reveal a man has devoured his offspring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somehow' rearranges HEY and TESTS; 'reveal' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Atreus served this king's sons to him at a banquet, so he unknowingly consumed them.

clue.text: Painful reminder of passion when taken to heart

definitions.text: Painful reminder of passion when taken to heart

parts.words: Painful reminder of passion when taken to heart
parts.note: plays on a pulse of pain, and on a heart-..., a person one is passionate about

explanation.definitionFit: A throb is a pulsing ache, and attached to heart it names an object of romantic passion.

clue.text: No tussle about a race course here

parts.note: O, the figure nought, stands for no or nothing

indicators.note: about says the word for tussle goes around the race

parts.note: a melee is a confused scuffle or fight
the TT is the Tourist Trophy motorcycle race on the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: An instruction that there is to be no brawling around the venue of a race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'race course' reads as one phrase but splits: 'race' is TT and 'course' is the definition, a dish in a meal; 'here' points to it.
explanation.definitionFit: An egg dish served as one part of a meal, such as a starter or main.

clue.text: Bay, for example, is certainly one of its objects of study

definitions.text: Bay, for example, is certainly one of its objects of study

parts.words: Bay, for example, is certainly one of its objects of study
parts.note: the bay tree is a plant studied by this science, and ... Bay in Australia, where Cook landed, is famously linked with it

explanation.definitionFit: The science of plants includes the laurel or bay tree, and Botany Bay was named for the specimens collected there.

clue.text: Sweet Dickensian do-gooder catches bachelor

indicators.note: catches says the do-gooder's name holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: Mrs Jellyby in Bleak House is the philanthropist who neglects her own family for good causes abroad
BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a common way to give bachelor

explanation.surface: A charitable character from Dickens captures an unmarried man.
explanation.walkthrough: A jelly baby is a British soft gummy sweet shaped like a baby; the Bleak House character is a byword for misplaced charity.
explanation.definitionFit: A gelatin confection moulded into a small human figure, sold as candy in Britain.

clue.text: Pooh's young friend accepts me as a lover

indicators.note: accepts says the young friend takes in the following word

parts.note: Roo is the baby kangaroo in Winnie-the-Pooh

explanation.surface: A child's storybook animal welcomes the speaker as a sweetheart.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's Veronese hero has become a byword for an ardent male admirer.

clue.text: Doctor called according to the rota

indicators.note: called signals that a word is spoken, so its sound and not its spelling counts

parts.note: taking each go in proper sequence is doing things in turn

explanation.surface: A physician was summoned when his scheduled duty came round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in turn' said out loud gives the spelling of the answer; in the US the word names a junior hospital doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: In American usage a recent medical graduate working in a hospital under supervision.

clue.text: Drab is a false label for this Shakespearian heroine

indicators.note: false indicates the words are not genuine as written and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A dull tag is wrongly attached to a character from Shakespeare's plays.
explanation.walkthrough: 'false' rearranges LABEL into BELLA, after IS A. The answer also names the heroine of Measure for Measure, so 'this Shakespearian heroine' gives a second hint.
explanation.definitionFit: As a colour name it is a greyish-yellow or dun shade, a dull brownish tint.

clue.text: Privileged admission to course

definitions.meaning: the right of access granted to someone, as into society
a dish in a meal, in Britain one before the main dish, in the US the main dish itself

explanation.surface: A special pass lets someone into a restaurant course.
explanation.definitionFit: The French word means both a right of entry and a dish served at dinner.

clue.text: He taught the Mock Turtle (obviously he had his own house)

definitions.text: He taught the Mock Turtle (obviously he had his own house)

parts.words: He taught the Mock Turtle (obviously he had his own house)
parts.note: in Alice's Adventures in Wonderland the Mock Turtle's schoolmaster was a turtle called by a punning name because he taught us; the bracket refers to a shell carried on the back

explanation.definitionFit: Lewis Carroll's Mock Turtle explains his old master was called this because 'he taught us', and such reptiles carry their shells.

clue.text: Mastering it may need solid study

definitions.text: Mastering it may need solid study

parts.words: Mastering it may need solid study
parts.note: solid study looks like hard work, but solid also names the branch dealing with three-dimensional shapes

explanation.definitionFit: The mathematics of shapes has a branch called solid, covering three-dimensional figures.

clue.text: Helping of beef, perhaps, from prize animal

parts.note: a medal is awarded as a prize
a lion is an animal

explanation.surface: A diner is served a cut of meat taken from a show-winning beast.
explanation.definitionFit: A small round cut of meat, often of beef, is served under this name.

clue.text: David, for example, has inferior act to Goliath — to start with

parts.note: under can mean lower in rank or inferior
a do is an act or deed, as in a do or a party

indicators.note: to start with tells us to take only the opening letter of the name Goliath

explanation.surface: The young biblical hero puts on a weaker show than the giant at first.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical shepherd boy who fought the giant is the classic example of the competitor expected to lose.

clue.text: His country's defeat means nothing to Russian composer

parts.note: Alexander Borodin wrote the opera Prince Igor
O, the figure nought, means nothing

explanation.surface: A Russian composer is untroubled by his homeland losing a battle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'His' refers to the composer: the 1812 battle near Moscow was a costly reverse for the Russian army before Napoleon took the city.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1812 battle where Napoleon's army forced the Russians to withdraw toward Moscow.

clue.text: Such a means to an end barely contemplated by Dane

definitions.text: Such a means to an end barely contemplated by Dane

parts.words: Such a means to an end barely contemplated by Dane
parts.note: Hamlet the Dane muses that a man might end his life 'with a bare' small dagger

explanation.definitionFit: In Hamlet's soliloquy the prince considers suicide with this short pointed blade.

clue.text: Notice a gap coming

parts.note: an ad, an advertisement, is a notice
a vent is an opening or gap

explanation.surface: A sign warns of an opening ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means an arrival, as of a notable person or event.

clue.text: Practised diner at buffet

indicators.note: to buffet is to knock about, so the letters before it are battered into new order

explanation.surface: An experienced restaurant-goer at a self-service meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'buffet' looks like a meal but is a verb meaning knock about, rearranging DINER AT.
explanation.definitionFit: Skilled through drill and practice, as a schooled performer is.

clue.text: He made himself a butt of cynicism

definitions.text: He made himself a butt of cynicism

parts.words: He made himself a butt of cynicism
parts.note: a butt is a large barrel, and the famous Cynic philosopher is said to have lived in a tub; butt also means a target of mockery

explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Greek Cynic philosopher was said to sleep in a large jar or barrel.

clue.text: Saints choose to be beheaded

indicators.note: beheaded means the first letter is taken off the word for choose

parts.note: to select is to choose

explanation.surface: Holy people decide on decapitation.
explanation.definitionFit: In theology those chosen by God for salvation are a plural group, like the saved.

clue.text: Naturally cold state, but sweet when baked

definitions.meaning: the northernmost US state, cold by its climate
a dessert of ice cream and sponge covered in meringue and browned in the oven

explanation.surface: A freezing region yields a pudding once it goes in the oven.
explanation.definitionFit: The Arctic US state shares its name with the meringue-covered dessert called Baked Alaska.

clue.text: Jazz or rock?

definitions.meaning: a big-band style of jazz popular in the 1930s and 40s
to rock is to sway back and forth

explanation.definitionFit: The name of a 1930s dance-band style is also a verb for swaying to and fro.

clue.text: A curious flower

parts.note: rum is British slang for odd or curious

explanation.surface: A strange bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: A lily-like plant with a hooded spathe, such as the cuckoo-pint.

clue.text: It 'may be forced to obtain a decision

definitions.text: It 'may be forced to obtain a decision

parts.words: It 'may be forced to obtain a decision
parts.note: refers to the idiom of forcing a matter to settle it

explanation.definitionFit: To force the point at stake is to push for a decision on the matter in dispute.

clue.text: Australian town boy can explain his selection, naturally

parts.note: Darwin is the capital of Australia's Northern Territory
Ian is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A lad from the Australian north is able to justify his choice, of course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'naturally' looks like 'of course' but points to natural selection: a follower of the naturalist's theory accounts for it.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower of the evolutionist's theory explains natural selection.

clue.text: How Jaques might think the, whole world was organised?

definitions.text: How Jaques might think the, whole world was organised?

parts.words: How Jaques might think the, whole world was organised?
parts.note: Jaques in As You Like It says all the world's a stage, so the world would be run as a theatre production

explanation.definitionFit: If the world is a theatre, its running would be controlled like a show by the backstage organiser.
